description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing the feed in a Vue.js frontend. It includes state variables, functions for loading the feed, creating posts, and toggling likes and shares, interacting with external API functions.

methods.name: loadFeed
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the feed from the API and updates the posts state.

methods.name: createPost
methods.description: Creates a new post by sending the payload to the API and prepends the new post to the posts list.

methods.name: toggleLike
methods.description: Optimistically toggles the like state of a post, updates via API, and rolls back on failure.

methods.name: toggleShare
methods.description: Optimistically toggles the share state of a post, updates via API, and rolls back on failure.
